report:
Fresh review of the current five-line claim, all three ordinary implementation entries (inspector.rs, associated.rs, mods.rs), and the complete single associated TODO test. No prior verdict substitutes for this assessment.

Requirements and current source: (1) One eager local directory: symbols() calls build_symbol_directory, which converts indexed_symbols into a single SymbolIndex and caches locators/references. indexed_symbols creates the root, and walk_symbols recursively includes represented module children, enum variants, and direct trait/impl associated members before returning. There is no search-time branch endpoint in this path. (2) Detail-free membership: SymbolSummary carries paths, labels, search text, presentation and child completeness. Product catalog/selection and signature/body products are separate operations. The associated.rs helpers obtain CST item names/occurrences and mint tracked associated symbols; lower_item copies CST and resolves spans, without checking owner signatures or associated values. (3) Exclusion of dependency symbols: canonical_children filters is_external before producing entries; ownership recursion operates only on local module/enum/trait/impl cases. Dependency references can appear in separately selected products, not as directory membership. (4) Macro exception: mods.rs enumerates expanded members, checks expansion completeness, and resolves macro definitions with new_for_macro_expansion, including is_builtin_derive metadata. Unsupported/failed expansion is marked incomplete, rather than silently represented as a complete lazy branch. This directory eagerly covers represented symbols; it does not promise implementation of unsupported macro expansion. The strict closed transitive metadata envelope still needs the explicitly deferred trace evidence.

Browser source dependencies were freshly captured using review read. InspectorApp's bootstrap requests one symbols response per bootstrap/revision, and SymbolDirectory constructs its parent-child map solely from that response. Search trims and lowercases a local needle and filters search_text in memory. Expansion toggles a local Set and SymbolRow reads existing children. Search modifies the q view parameter, whereas the API symbols URL is fixed and takes no query. No search text or branch request is constructed by these paths. The browser test file was also captured: its assertions exercise reflected rendering, canonical links, truncation and cycles, not directory search. It is not treated as this anchor's behavioral coverage.

Test assessment: the complete associated set contains only sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_detail_free_index. It has no assertions and supplies no executed behavioral verification. Its explicit deferral accounts for the full claim: source-backed integration fixtures with nested modules, associated items, macro output and dependencies; a browser request recorder; assertions for complete membership, excluded dependencies/details, permitted macro metadata and forbidden signatures/bodies/associated values/impl discovery, plus correct filtered results and zero search/branch network requests. Those fixtures, recorder and reviewed assertions are the stated prerequisites. This remains an accepted TODO, not a claim of adequate completed test coverage. A regression introducing an eager semantic call or search request would not be detected by the placeholder; the deferred closed trace and request assertions are specifically intended to detect it. There are no N/A entries.

All essential directly reviewed Rust membership/expansion helpers are in associated implementation files. TypeScript dependencies were captured explicitly, as the Rust association inventory cannot attach them. No production or test source was changed in this refresh. Commands executed here were review start and review read plus source inspection; no test or build execution is claimed. The root agent runs central suites separately. No additional edits are required to accept the current implementation-source assessment with the honest explicit test deferral.
